displayPattern: PCBHR104 unitary diagnostic display in Goodman service manual RS6200007 r27 (ASXC, DSXC, GSXC condensing units and ASZC, DSZC, GSZC heat pumps). Digit 3 is blank. Digit 2 is 0 and digit 1 is 9. The code is 09
meaning: Low pilot voltage. The air conditioner or heat pump may appear to be operating normally. The chart's note says the control detects secondary voltage less than 18 VAC.
diySteps: Write down 09. This is the low-voltage secondary circuit, not line-voltage code 08 or L8
Technician: check the fuse, correct the low secondary voltage, and check the transformer. The chart says the fault clears if secondary voltage rises above 21 VAC
proAdvice: Call a licensed HVAC technician. The 18 VAC and 21 VAC figures are the PCBHR104 notes for 09. They are meter readings, not a homeowner test.
safetyNote: Outdoor units carry line voltage even when the thermostat is off. Switch off the unit's disconnect and breaker before touching anything. Refrigerant, wiring, compressor and control-board work must be done by a licensed HVAC technician.
